_note: Exact versions only: the newest stable release at least two weeks old on the date below, tested together by tests/new-project-test.sh. Update them only in a base release with that test passing.
_nest: NestJS packages (@nestjs/*, reflect-metadata, rxjs) checked on 2026-10-30: 12.1.3 of 2026-10-12 (12.3.2 of 2026-10-27 is too new), @nestjs/cli 12.0.8, @nestjs/schematics 12.0.7 (direct, so `nest g` always finds it). @nestjs/platform-fastify 12.1.3 pins fastify 5.12.5, two patches behind fastify below; osv lists only a LOW for it (CVSS 3.7). A Nest project names that fastify itself (nest_fastify): pnpm resolves an import only from the project's own package.json, and the adapter's version keeps a single copy, the one the types describe (tests/new-project-test.sh fails on a second one). It changes with the adapter.
_typescript: TypeScript stays on 6.0.3: 7.0.2 of 2026-07-08 is outside the peer range of typescript-eslint 8 (<6.1.0) and of @nestjs/cli 12 (~6.0.2). @types/node follows the Node line below, not the newest major: 26.6.5 of 2026-10-09, checked on 2026-11-07 (26.6.6 of 2026-10-28 is too new).
_node: Node line of every project (.nvmrc, engines, the Docker images): the newest Active LTS, two weeks after its LTS start (owner's decision 2026-11-03); 26 ahead of that date, by the owner's decision of 2026-11-07. node_lines: LTS start and end of life of each LTS line from github.com/nodejs/Release schedule.json, checked on 2026-11-07; from 27 on, one major a year with LTS in October.
_pnpm: packageManager of every project, checked on 2026-11-03: 12.14.0 of 2026-10-15 (12.15.0 of 2026-10-21 is too new). Node 25 and later ship no corepack: Docker installs this version with npm install --global --allow-scripts=pnpm, so pnpm's own install script links its native binary (npm 11.20 of Node 26 runs a script left out of allow-scripts with a warning, a later npm may skip it); a pnpm of another version downloads it itself (pmOnFail: download). pnpm 11 and later read only auth and registry settings from .npmrc, the rest from pnpm-workspace.yaml.
_pgvector: Docker Hub tag of 2026-10-01 for module pgvector: the same Postgres major as above, Debian based, there is no Alpine image. The module's compose files take it instead of the postgres image.
_overrides: pnpm overrides (pnpm-workspace.yaml) for a vulnerable transitive package of a release, an exact fixed version at least two weeks old, dropped once a release ships the fix. Empty since Prisma 7.10.1, which pins deepmerge-ts 8.0.2 and mysql2 3.24.4 itself (osv clean on 2026-10-30).
